findings.description: The deleted __reduce_ex__ made pickling reconstruct the sentinel member by name via getattr(Sentinel, name), preserving singleton identity. Without it, Enum's default reduce uses the member's _value_ (a bare object()). Unpickling then calls Sentinel(<new object>), which raises ValueError, or yields a member that fails identity checks such as `value is UNSET`. Any Parameter or Option holding UNSET that is pickled, for example to send it to a worker process, will fail or lose its sentinel identity.
findings.suggestion: Restore __reduce_ex__ returning getattr, (self.__class__, self.name), or keep the removal only if pickling of these objects is confirmed unsupported and no caller relies on it.
